WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2026-01-25'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups d USING (receipt_id, line_no) ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 24

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c, COUNT(DISTINCT sale_date) ds, MIN(sale_date) d0, MIN(etl_loaded_at) e0, MAX(etl_loaded_at) e1
  FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2026-01-25'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT date_trunc('month', d0) m, c, COUNT(*) n, MIN(e0), MAX(e1), SUM(CASE WHEN e0=e1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) same_etl FROM dups GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
                FROM dim_date
                WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26') AND fiscal_quarter = 3) d
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2025-10-27' - 364)
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.region, ROUND(ty.net_sales,2) AS this_year, ROUND(ly.net_sales,2) AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' ORDER BY ty.region

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT n.store_id, d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) mine
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1,2),
ctl AS (
  SELECT r.store_id, d.fiscal_year, SUM(r.net_sales) ctl
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND r.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) store_id, COALESCE(m.fiscal_year,c.fiscal_year) fy, ROUND(m.mine,2) mine, ROUND(c.ctl,2) ctl, ROUND(COALESCE(m.mine,0)-COALESCE(c.ctl,0),2) diff
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON m.store_id=c.store_id AND m.fiscal_year=c.fiscal_year
WHERE ABS(COALESCE(m.mine,0)-COALESCE(c.ctl,0))>0.5 ORDER BY 1,2
